tables.label: Table 3

footnotes: MIC and MICcomb MIC of antifungal protein/peptide when applied alone and in combination, respectively. Type of the interaction: 0.5 ≤ FICI ≤ 4.0: additive or indifference, FICI < 0.5: synergy, FICI > 4.0: antagonism (Pillai et al. 2005)
